title: Leads
description: Customers who shared their contact information
emptySub: When a customer shares their phone number in a conversation, they'll appear here automatically.
leadsDisabled: Lead collection is disabled for all pages
leadsDisabledSub: Enable lead collection from Page Settings to start capturing leads automatically.
name: Name
customizeStagesDesc: Make the leads page fit your business: add follow-up stages with your own names (e.g. "Shipped", "Delivered" for a store) and data fields you fill in per customer (e.g. "Amount paid"). Everything appears on lead cards and in the CSV export.
noSubStagesYet: No sub-stages yet — add what fits your business.
customFieldsDesc: Fields you fill in for each lead from the detail panel — like amount paid or discount. They also appear as columns in the CSV export.
templateApplied: Template applied — edit it freely, then save
templateOverwriteMessage: Applying a template replaces the stages and fields you've configured. Leads keep all their data — ones tagged with old stages show the main status badge until you pick a new stage. Nothing is saved until you press Save.
exportFailed: Failed to export. Please try again.
deepLinkNotFound: This lead may have already been removed.
deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this lead?
selectPage: Select a page to view leads
upgradeDescription: Automatically capture phone numbers and contact details from your AI conversations. Available on Starter plan and above.
